item.title: From cells to kennels: Las Vegas inmates help clean animal shelter
item.description: From behind jail bars to helping shelter animals behind kennel bars, a unique partnership between the city of Las Vegas and the Animal Foundation brings a small group of inmates to the Animal Foundation twice a week.

item.title: VIDEO: Las Vegas casino implosion caught on camera
item.description: The long-closed Eastside Cannery casino on the Boulder Strip was imploded Thursday morning after closing during the COVID-19 pandemic and never reopening.

item.title: Las Vegas police: Tourist stole, tortured flamingo at iconic Strip hotel
item.description: A Canadian tourist faces charges after Las Vegas police said he stole a flamingo from the Flamingo hotel and took the bird back to his room, injuring it.

item.title: Visitors at Flamingo Las Vegas wildlife habitat react to man accused of stealing, torturing flamingo
item.description: Discussions of the man who police say stole and tortured a flamingo were common at the Flamingo Las Vegas Hotel and Casino’s wildlife habitat Thursday.

item.title: 15 Nevada wild horses headed for slaughter in Mexico, rescue group says
item.description: A national rescue organization has identified 15 horses from Nevada BLM roundups among animals eligible for slaughter in a Texas "kill pen."

Victor Luis Arriola was arrested on state charges and booked into the Clark County Detention Center pending further investigation, according to police. item.title: Las Vegas bio lab contained human samples, testing materials, FBI says
item.description: A suspected bio lab located inside a Las Vegas garage contained materials to create test kits, compounds for Influenza vaccines and human biological samples, the 8 News Now Investigators have learned.

item.title: David Copperfield announces final shows at Las Vegas' MGM Grand
item.description: For 25 years, David Copperfield has been entertaining visitors to the MGM Grand in Las Vegas, and now we know when his show will come to an end.
